text:
Hello, my name is Valentina. I am currently going through a process together with my husband Israeli; I hold an A5 visa.

My husband recently graduated from a cybersecurity course and is looking for his first opportunity as a junior in the field. He is also a reservist soldier and has served in combat in both Lebanon and Gaza.

At the moment, he feels a bit lost in different aspects of his life, as the situation has been affecting him deeply. The field is quite competitive, and it has been difficult for him to secure even interviews. For this reason, any recommendation, contact, or information about junior cybersecurity positions would be greatly appreciated so he can start gaining experience.

He speaks Hebrew and Spanish, a bit of English, he has 26 years old.

If you know of anyone or any opportunity, I would be happy to connect you with him.

Thank you very much in advance! 🙏🏻

I send picture of us to get some attention..
